'''Asset SF-5''', also referred to as '''Shroud SF-5''', was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Asset SF-5 was sent to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] to dispose of [[Shroud SF-4]]'s body and belongings, and to observe the outcome of the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]].
